overview.description: The Bitwise Dogecoin ETF (BWOW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long doge, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund, seeking exposure to the daily price movements, net of expenses, of Dogecoins (DOGE) in USD. The Trust holds the crypto tokens in high-security, offline, multi-layer cold storage vaults. BWOW was launched on Nov 25, 2025 and is issued by Bitwise.
